work.name: Industry Internship
work.summary: Developed an intelligent question-answering system for manufacturing operations and applied domain-adaptation techniques for LLM-based industrial assistance.
highlights: Built real-time question-answering workflows for factory-floor inquiries and contingency guidance.
Applied RAG, SFT, and LoRA for domain-specific LLM adaptation.
Studied modern post-training and reinforcement-learning methods including PPO and GRPO.

projects.name: Multi-Source Attack Path Reconstruction with Weighted Attack Graphs
projects.description: NICS-sponsored cyber threat analysis system integrating Zeek/NetFlow, Suricata, Wazuh, and VirusTotal CTI with transformer-based threat scoring and weighted attack-graph reconstruction.
highlights: Designed a dual-stream MaliciousFlowTransformer + SecureBERT 2.0 threat-scoring model.
Implemented reverse beam search over a multi-source weighted attack graph.
Deployed on TWCC using Docker Compose.
Achieved F1 scores of 1.0000 on DARPA 2000 and a custom TWCC testbed, and 0.9730 on the full six-day ISCXIDS2012 dataset in the evaluated scenarios.

projects.name: NYCU-Bot — Multi-Agent Award Announcement & Social Media Automation
projects.description: Hierarchical multi-agent system that monitors award announcements and generates bilingual social-media posts.
highlights: Implemented coordinator and platform-specific agents through an internal message bus.
Used LangChain with a locally hosted DeepSeek-R1 7B model via Ollama.
Supported X/Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and Reddit publishing workflows.

projects.name: Intelligent Research Companion
projects.description: Multi-agent academic paper analysis system using OCR, citation extraction, automated reference retrieval, RAG, and local LLMs.

projects.name: Agrivoltaics Smart Micro-grid for Leisure Farms
projects.description: AI- and IoT-enabled agrivoltaics system for solar monitoring, anomaly detection, lighting control, and yield prediction.

projects.name: AI-Based Video Analysis for Badminton Strategy
projects.description: Computer-vision capstone using YOLOv7 and OpenPose for badminton video and posture analysis.
